individual_id.description: PERNR of the individual the case belongs to, so the case can open their Career Pathway view.

appointment.description: Workbook appointment label the case is raised against — the appointment expected to be vacated.

trigger_date.description: APPT END — the date this case is planned against. A trigger for planning only, never confirmation of approval.

case_type.description: Succession case (fill the appointment being vacated) or Posting case (the individual approaching the end of their appointment).
